what: The Soul CLI and Soul guides every launcher world serves (/eden-agent.mjs, /skill.md, /instructions.md). Exact copies, never forks.

cli.note: trunk release 3: 1.9 + owner inbox listen/ack, look around (knowledge), travel, stroll in place, owner queue protection, speech truth, first wait reads from c_0, profile photo auto / body photo, looks v2 (accessories, outfits, shape); body-shape numbers parsed; 1.9.3: approval start/poll/cancel retry a restarting world (no answer, 429, 5xx) until their deadline, refused approvals print their reason; 1.9.4: create-soul/pair-soul --for <window code> puts the request in the human's open Sim window; approval wait keeps polling through a timed-out request (the human can Ask again) until its 15-min deadline; 1.9.5 (lane MSG): listen blocks with no time limit and prints every waiting owner message oldest first (no credential, emittedAt), outages (and connections dropped mid-answer) retried; --follow prints a whole backlog; result <id> done|failed "..."; 1.9.6 (lane SOULSIM-H): wait ends the moment the owner writes (world ownerWrote/ownerMark) and prints their messages (ownerMessages + stderr OWNER MESSAGE); listen's next line: ack the batch at once, listen --after <last id> before the work; 1.9.7 (lane SOULSIM-H F5): a message the agent acked after its walk began lifts the in-progress guard, so a plain act replaces the walk; 1.9.8 (lane SOULSIM-E): a stale approval wait ends as "superseded" and never clears the newer request made after a cancel (no orphan Soul); a mind boots on worlds over 1,000 places (place limit 100k, an unusable hierarchy only turns ancestor arrivals off), Soul roster cap 100k 1.9.9 (lane soul-eyes-on): a Soul may show its owner what it sees (view --out, view --map --out).

skill.note: template; the world fills {{BASE}}. Includes owner inbox, knowledge at scales, travel, creature guidance and looks v2 / portraits. 1.9.5 (lane MSG): always listen from the moment the Soul is ready, every mode; never filter listen; ack then result; work through a backlog; if listen ends without messages, start it again. 1.9.6 (lane SOULSIM-H): ack a whole batch at once, restart listen --after <last id> before the work, wait 60 (never sleep) during actions, act a replacing message at once, ignore ids already acked. 1.9.7: ack first, then a plain act replaces the walk. One wait 60 per command, never a for-loop of waits. 1.9.8: approval wait runs in the background in the create flow; a rename = approval cancel, create-soul, new background wait (the old one ends as superseded). 1.9.9: version only.

instructions.note: template; the world fills {{BASE}} and {{WORLD}}. Release 3 adds one "Your resident's look" paragraph (lane D); otherwise as publication-20be-001. 1.9.4 (lane PUX): the New Soul prompt fills --for <window code> (instructions.md?for=CODE). 1.9.5 (lane MSG): step 4 starts listening at once, without asking; the mode question is step 5. 1.9.6 (lane SOULSIM-H + QA2 F9): step 3 names the CLI URL (curl -fsSo eden-agent.mjs {{BASE}}/eden-agent.mjs); step 4 follows the batch/wait order. 1.9.8 (lane SOULSIM-E): step 3 runs approval wait in the background and says how to rename.

appendix: The per-world entry skill (/SKILL.md: God mode + Soul mode) stays tools/world-skill/SKILL.md; its Soul mode points here.
